primarySource.title: Anatomically curated segmentation of human subcortical structures in high resolution magnetic resonance imaging: An open science approach
sections: Methods: Datasets (0.7mm isotropic T1w HCP images)
primarySource.support: Coronal pallidal location, axial posterior-end cross-check, and inconsistent internal/external segment separation in high-resolution T1w research images.
primarySource.reuse: Original short paraphrase and citation only. No figures, scan data, segmentation files, tables or verbatim passages copied.

prose: On coronal MRI, locate the pallidum between the putamen laterally and the internal capsule medially, then follow its posterior taper. Cross-check the posterior endpoint on axial images when it is unclear on coronal views. The cited manual-segmentation study used 0.7 mm isotropic T1-weighted research scans; internal and external pallidal segments were not consistently distinguishable even in that setting. Routine sequences may provide less detail.
